criteria.detail: 2025-04: 151,300 rows, item named in ITEM_DESC/CS_DESC; 2026-08: 94,010 rows, item named in CS_DESC; 10 items, valid quotes per item 66 to 252; 12 region codes as the glossary numbers them; 8 rates on 5 cached pages; every item and occupation carries the words expected
criteria.name: B144-D0
criteria.statement: The quote files, the pay tables, the glossary and the government pages say what the reading takes them to say.

criteria.detail: plumber posted 50.00 paid 18.00, wedge 2.78 (2.73 to 3.30 over 8 knob points; resamples 2.53 to 3.31), 2.01 after statute, 3.9 own hours, 19p taken home per pound earned; electrician posted 42.00 paid 19.00, wedge 2.21 (2.16 to 2.67 over 8 knob points; resamples 1.89 to 2.58), 1.60 after statute, 3.1 own hours, 23p taken home per pound earned; carpenter posted 25.00 paid 16.98, wedge 1.47 (1.42 to 1.75 over 8 knob points; resamples 1.33 to 1.79), 1.07 after statute, 2.0 own hours, 35p taken home per pound earned; domestic cleaner posted 17.00 paid 12.63, wedge 1.35 (1.25 to 1.48 over 8 knob points; resamples 1.30 to 1.43), 0.98 after statute, 1.9 own hours, 39p taken home per pound earned; home care assistant posted 27.05 paid 13.45, wedge 2.01 (1.86 to 2.23 over 8 knob points; resamples 1.89 to 2.15), 1.46 after statute, 2.8 own hours, 26p taken home per pound earned; driving lesson posted 40.00 paid 19.84, wedge 2.02 (1.57 to 2.04 over 8 knob points; resamples 1.58 to 2.48), 1.46 after statute, 2.8 own hours, 26p taken home per pound earned; solicitor posted 306.00 paid 30.66, wedge 9.98 (8.23 to 11.15 over 8 knob points; resamples 9.14 to 11.17), 7.23 after statute, 13.9 own hours, 5p taken home per pound earned. Above one at every knob point: 7 of 7; above everything statute can add (1.38) at every knob point: 6 of 7
criteria.name: B144-D1
criteria.statement: An hour that one customer buys alone is posted above the hourly pay of the occupation that does it.

criteria.detail: childminder posted 5.50 to each customer, paid 13.00, wedge 0.42 (0.41 to 0.50 over 8 knob points; resamples 0.36 to 0.48); 2.4 customers cover the pay (2.0 to 2.4), the rule allows 6, of whom 3 young -> shared and covered
criteria.name: B144-D2
criteria.statement: An hour that several customers share is posted to each below that pay, and the pay is covered within the number the rule allows.

criteria.detail: wedges in order: domestic cleaner 1.35, carpenter 1.47, home care assistant 2.01, driving lesson 2.02, electrician 2.21, plumber 2.78, solicitor 9.98. Largest over smallest 7.4 times (log 2.003); with any one occupation left out at least 2.1 times (log 0.725); the largest spread of 400 one-wedge worlds, log 0.532. Over 8 knob points the left-out spread is 0.725 to 0.887 against floors up to 0.567; more than one wedge at 8 of 8
criteria.name: B144-D3
criteria.statement: The wedge between the posted hour and the paid hour is not one number across occupations.

criteria.detail: 83 cells, 8 items in 11 regions: the posted price against the region's pay +0.813, the occupation's pay against it +0.308, gap +0.505 (-0.014 to +0.676 over 32 knob points; region resamples -0.321 to +0.958). Without London: price +0.341 to +0.858, pay +0.181 to +0.354. By item: carpenter price +1.21 pay +0.51 (pay over the floor 1.39); decorator price -0.07 pay -0.10 (pay over the floor 1.29); domestic cleaner price +0.13 pay +0.28 (pay over the floor 1.03); electrician price +1.51 pay +0.24 (pay over the floor 1.56); home care assistant price -0.01 pay +0.17 (pay over the floor 1.10); man's haircut price +0.55 pay -0.02 (pay over the floor 1.01); plumber price +2.39 pay +0.40 (pay over the floor 1.47); solicitor price +0.75 pay +1.06 (pay over the floor 2.51) -> unread
criteria.name: B144-D4
criteria.statement: Across regions the posted price follows the region's pay more closely than the pay of the occupation does.

criteria.detail: 274 occupations: the slope of an occupation's pay on the region's pay rises by +0.486 per log point of its national pay over the floor; relabelled occupations return -0.309 to +0.258 in 2000 relabellings; over 8 knob points the relation is +0.462 to +0.770 against a largest relabelled +0.585; above its own largest relabelling at 7 of 8 knob points (inside it at median, without London, 0 regions missing: +0.497 against +0.585). Mean slope by distance from the floor: within 10% of the floor +0.16 (33 occupations); 10% to 50% above +0.35 (134 occupations); 50% to 100% above +0.49 (63 occupations); more than double +0.65 (44 occupations) -> ours
criteria.name: B144-D5
criteria.rival_entailment: Then every occupation's pay follows the region's level by the same amount, and the slope of an occupation's pay on the region's pay is unrelated to how far its national pay stands above the wage floor: what a relabelling of occupations gives.
criteria.rival_premise: A region has one pay level: the pay of an occupation in a region is the occupation's own level times the region's, log w(occupation, region) = a(occupation) + m(region).
criteria.statement: Pay follows the region's pay the less, the nearer the occupation's national pay sits to the wage floor written for the whole country. Passing means the rival is wrong here (`11e`).

diagnostic_reason: the station is open: its arms are read one at a time and it has not been closed

states.above one: above one at every knob point
states.below one: below one at every knob point
states.unread: the side changes somewhere on the knob grid, or a number is missing

states_of_the_floor.opposite: below the smallest any relabelling returns at the reference point, and negative at every knob point
states_of_the_floor.ours: above the largest any relabelling returns at the reference point, and positive at every knob point
states_of_the_floor.unread: inside the relabelling range at the reference point, or the sign changes somewhere on the knob grid, or too few occupations

states_of_the_gap.pay steeper: the occupation's pay follows the region's pay more, at every knob point
states_of_the_gap.price steeper: the posted price follows the region's pay more than the occupation's pay does, at every knob point
states_of_the_gap.unread: the order changes somewhere on the knob grid, or a slope is undefined

states_of_the_shared_hour.not shared: each customer pays more than the pay at every knob point, or the pay cannot be covered within the number the rule allows at any knob point
states_of_the_shared_hour.shared and covered: each customer pays less than the pay at every knob point and the pay is covered within the number the rule allows

states_of_the_spread.more than one wedge: with any one occupation left out the spread is above the floor
states_of_the_spread.one wedge: the spread over all occupations is within the floor
states_of_the_spread.unread: above the floor only while one particular occupation is in

mapping.verdict: true when every state is the stated one, false when none is and none is unread, null otherwise
